entry.title: Keeping the learning real: an integrated approach to academic integrity in the age of AI
entry.summary:
I-Wonkhe nenkampani yokuhlola ukuziphatha kwabafundi i-Studiosity baphenyisisa inqubomgomo yamanyuvesi e-United Kingdom, baphinde babamba izingxoxo nabaholi bezikhungo nabafundi ngoSeptemba 2026, bagxila ebuqotho bezifundo ngesikhathi se-AI ekhiqizayo. Umbiko wabo, owakhishwa ngomhla ka-4 Okthoba 2026, uveza ukuthi izikhungo ziqala ukushiya indlela yokuqapha ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ngamathuluzi okuyibona, zithatha indlela yokuqamba kabusha izindlela zokuhlola, ukufundisa ulwazi lokusebenzisa i-AI, nezindlela ezingajeziseki zokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukufunda kuyenzeka ngempela. Uphawula ukuthi uhlelo lobuqotho bezifundo lusengenawo ukuhlangana okuphelele, futhi abafundi basengabathembekile kulo, bengabaza ukuthi izikhungo zizowakholelwa amazwi abo mayelana nendlela abasebenzise ngayo i-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola nobuqotho bezifundo, lona ngumbiko ocacile, waphezulu, wendlela ohlelo lwemfundo ephakeme olukhulu oluqamba kabusha ukuhlolwa esikhundleni sokuzama nje ukubona ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI, futhi unikeza uhlaka olusebenzayo lokuqondisa abasebenzi nabafundi.

Wonkhe / Studiosity · UK higher education policy platform report, based on institutional policy review and sector roundtables

entry.title: Digital solidification: learning analytics, the panopticon, and data coloniality in South African higher education
entry.summary:
USingh, we-University of Johannesburg, uphakamisa ukuthi ukuhlaziywa kokufunda kwabafundi kungasebenza njenge-digital panopticon, iso elihlala libukele, eliguqula izithiyo zesikhashana, njengokucima kwamandla kagesi noma ukuntuleka kwedatha yeselula, kube izimpawu zokusilela ezilandela umfundi unomphela, ngaphakathi kohlaka lobukoloni bedatha. Iphepha alithi ukuhlaziywa kokufunda akubi yingozi ngazo zonke izikhathi, kodwa liyaxwayisa ukuthi izimpawu ezingaphonswa inselelo noma zibuyekezwe zenza kakhulu izimo ezingalingani zeNingizimu Afrika zezinsiza nezolimi. Liphakamisa uhlaka olugxile ebulungisweni bomphakathi, olusekelwe ekuxolelweni kwedatha, ukucwaningwa kwama-algorithm okubandakanya abafundi, nokuqondwa kwezimpawu ngokulandela isimo njengesikhuthazo sosizo, hhayi isijeziso.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuyingxoxo ebuyekeziwe ngochwepheshe eqondile yaseNingizimu Afrika, mayelana namathuluzi okuhlaziya okubikezelayo asekujuleni kwensika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha okubikezelayo kuphumelelo labafundi, futhi inikeza insika yeqembu ephathelene ne-AI enokuzibophezela, ukwenza okuqondile nokulingana izivikelo ezisekelwe kucatshangelwa ngaphambi kokuncoma izinhlelo zesexwayiso sangaphambili.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Helpful or harmful? Generative AI dependence, self-reported critical thinking disposition, and self-perceived employability among business students
entry.summary:
OShojaei nozakwabo baphenyisisa abafundi beziqu zokuqala bezamabhizinisi abangu-412 emanyuvesi amathathu e-Oman, mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekhiqizayo, ukuncika kuyo, ukucabanga okujulile, nokuzibona ngendlela yokuqasheka. Ukusetshenziswa okukhulu kwe-AI kwahlobana nokuzibona kuqashekile ngokuphezulu, kodwa ukuncika okukhulu ku-AI kwahlobana nokucabanga okujulile okuncane, futhi kwenza buthaka ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kokusetshenziswa kwe-AI nokuqasheka, kwaze kwaphelelwa ukubaluleka kwezibalo lapho ukuncika kuphakeme kakhulu. Ababhali baphetha ngokuthi izinzuzo zincike ekusebenziseni i-AI ngokucabangisisa nokuhlola okuyifezayo, hhayi esibalweni sokuyisebenzisa, nakuba indlela yocwaningo esekelwe emibikweni yabafundi ngokwabo, engabhekwanga isikhathi eside, ikhawulela ukusho ngqo isizathu nemiphumela.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kukhuluma ngqo kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ephathelene ne-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu nokuqasheka, ibonisa ukuthi ukuncika ku-AI ngaphandle kokuhlaziya kungaphazamisa ikhono elifiselwa abaqashi, isixwayiso esifaneleka ohlelweni lokuqasheka emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Assessment practices resistant to inappropriate AI use in Open Distance eLearning: insights from Zimbabwe Open University
entry.summary:
OMagwa noZongozzi, be-University of South Africa, baxoxisana nothisha, abafundi kanye nomxhumanisi wesiqinisekiso sekhwalithi enkampasini yeMasvingo yase-Zimbabwe Open University, bebuza ukuthi yiluphi uhlobo lokuhlolwa olumelana nokusetshenziswa okungafanele kwe-AI ekhiqizayo. Bathola ukuthi ukuhlolwa okusekelwe ekwenzeni, ukucabangisisa, ukuhlolwa ngomlomo, kanye nokuhlolwa kokufunda okubukwa eduze, kwabonakala kungukuhlolwa okunzima ukukuqeda ngokungathembeki kusetshenziswa i-AI, kodwa lokhu kuphakamisa ukukhathazeka ngomthwalo womsebenzi wothisha nangosayizi wekilasi. Ababhali baxwayisa ukuthi okutholakele kusuka enkampasini eyodwa yesifunda akungeniswa esivivinyeni sayo yonke isikhungo noma ukufunda okuqhutshwa ukusuka kude ngokubanzi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kunikeza umbono wamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba, ophathelene nokufunda okuqhutshwa ukusuka kude, mayelana nokuqamba kabusha ukuhlolwa ukumelana nokusetshenziswa okungafanele kwe-AI ekhiqizayo kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD yeAI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, futhi kufaneleka ngqo nohlelo lokufunda okuqhutshwa ukusuka kude kuleli lizwekazi.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Automated software scoring of senior school certificate examination mathematical items in economics using a contextual similarity model
entry.summary:
OOlaoye, Owolabi noOlaoye bahlola uhlelo lwekhompyutha olwakha amamaki ngokuzenzakalelayo emibuzweni yezibalo ehlobene ne-Economics yamabanga aphakeme esifundeni esisentshonalanga neningizimu yeNigeria, basebenzisa isampula labafundi abangu-1,008 kusukela enanini labangenele isivivinyo abacishe babe-275,000. Amamaki aphuma kuhlelo avumelana kakhulu nawaphuma kubahloli abayishumi nambili abaqeqeshiwe, ngokuhlobana okuphakeme okukalwa ngokuhlanganisa, okungu-0.863. Ababhali baphawula ukuthi uvivinyo lwaluphathelene nemibuzo emibili kuphela nokuthi umhloli ngamunye wahlola imiqulu engu-84 kuphela, ngakho kusadingeka ukuqinisekiswa okwengeziwe ngaphambi kokuthi lusetshenziswe kabanzi kuzivivinyo ezifana neWAEC, iNECO neNABTEB.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Lokhu kuyisibonelo esiqondile, esihlobene ne-STEM, sokusetshenziswa kokuhlaziya ukuhlolwa esivivinywe kuzinga lokuzwelonke lesivivinyo eNtshonalanga Afrika, kufaneleka ngqo kwinsika ka-Wits AHEAD yeAI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM kanye nezinhlelo zemfundo ezinkulu.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Six publishers agree to feed 20 million research papers to AI agents, in a pay-per-use deal
entry.summary:
Abashicileli bezincwadi zocwaningo abayisithupha, kuhlanganise i-Sage, i-BMJ Group kanye ne-Institute of Physics, bavumelene ukuvumela inkampani entsha yaseSweden i-Redpine ukuthi inikeze ama-ejenti we-AI ukufinyelela emaphepheni acwaningwe ngontanga angaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-20, ngesikhathi sangempela, kusho i-Times Higher Education ngomhla zi-6 kuMfumfu 2026. Lesi sivumelwano sokukhokha ngokusetshenziswa sikhokhela abashicileli kanye nababhali njalo uma uhlelo lwe-AI lusebenzisa umsebenzi wabo, kuhlanganise amajenali emkhakheni wezempilo, isayensi yokuphila nesayensi yemvelo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, lesi sivumelwano siwuvivinyo wokuqala wendlela ukushicilelwa kocwaningo okungagcina i-AI isekelwe kocwaningo oluqinisekisiwe kunokuqagela, kuyilapho kulungiswa ukuthi ubani okhokhelwa uma umshini, hhayi umfundi, ewucaphuna umsebenzi.

Times Higher Education · Established press (Times Higher Education)

entry.title: Mystery-shopper study finds university enquiry replies 'costing enrolments', as ChatGPT outperforms
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lohlobo lwe-mystery shopper olwenziwe emanyuvesi angu-33 e-United Kingdom nangu-30 e-Australia, oluqhutshwe yinkampani yezeluleko i-Edified kanye nenkampani yokuqasha abafundi i-UniQuest, futhi olubikwe yi-Times Higher Education ngomhla zi-1 kuMfumfu 2026, luthole ukuthi amaphesenti angu-37 kuphela emibuzweni engaba-700 yabafundi abafisa ukubhalisa athole impendulo eyabakhuthazayo ukuqhubeka nokuxhumana. Amaphesenti angu-15 emibuzo awatholakalelwa impendulo nhlobo, futhi izimpendulo ze-ChatGPT zathola amamaki aphezulu ngokushesha, ngokuphelele kanye nokuncenga kunezimpendulo zamanyuvesi uqobo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika ka-Wits AHEAD yokuhlaziywa kwedatha ohlelweni lwezemfundo nasekuthathweni kwezinqumo, lolu cwaningo luyisikhumbuzo esiqondile sokuthi izikhungo eziqoqa idatha mayelana nabafundi abafisa ukubhalisa kudingeka futhi zisebenzise lolu lwazi, njengoba cishe ababili kwabathathu babafundi abafisa ukubhalisa ocwaningweni basala bengakholwa yimpendulo yomuntu, ekwazi ukunqotshwa yi-AI ephothwe kahle.

Times Higher Education · Established press (Times Higher Education), citing a study by Edified and UniQuest

entry.title: How computer-science students actually use large language models varies sharply by task, study finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha locwaningo elifakwe ku-arXiv ngomhla zi-1 kuMfumfu 2026 lihlaziya indlela abafundi beziqu zokuqala abangu-211 abasebenzisa ngayo ama-LLM emamojuli ayisikhombisa esifundweni sokuxazulula izinkinga kwisayensi yekhompyutha. Abafundi basebenzisa lawa mathuluzi kakhulu emisebenzini ye-algorithms nokuthuthukiswa kwamawebhusayithi, futhi kancane kakhulu emisebenzini yobunjiniyela bezinhlelo zokusebenza, bevame ukuwabheka njengabasizi okufanele bahlolwe, hhayi njengamagunya okuwathemba ngokuphelele, baqinisekisa imiphumela ngokuzivivinya emisebenzini enesakhiwo esicacile, futhi basesha ku-inthanethi emisebenzini evulekile.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, lokhu okutholakele, ukuthi indlela abafundi abaqinisekisa ngayo imiphumela iguquka ngokuya ngomsebenzi, hhayi ngomfundi kuphela, kuwuphawu oluqondile lokuthi ubuqotho bezemfundo nokuklanywa kokuhlolwa kudinga kuguquke umsebenzi ngomsebenzi.

arXiv · Working paper (arXiv preprint)

entry.title: Cross-border virtual teamwork lifts intercultural readiness in data-analytics and machine-learning courses, study finds
entry.summary:
Iphepha locwaningo elifakwe ku-arXiv ngomhla zi-1 kuMfumfu 2026 ngu-Sehrish Basir Nizamani nozakwabo lichaza uhlelo lokuxhumana ngobuchwepheshe olumi ngesakhiwo, olwahlanganisa abafundi beziqu zokuqala abafunda ikhompyutha e-United States nase-Pakistan kuphrojekthi yezigaba eziyisithupha yokuhlaziywa kwedatha nokufunda kwemishini, eyenziwa bengavumelene ngesikhathi. Abafundi babika ulwazi oluhle ngokuqhubekayo, futhi abacwaningi bathola ukuthi ukuxhumana phakathi kwamasiko ahlukene, kunekhono lobuchwepheshe, kwaba yinto eyadonsa kakhulu umuzwa wabo wokuzimisela wokusebenza emhlabeni jikelele.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika ka-Wits AHEAD ye-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nemfundo yothisha, lolu cwaningo lunikeza isibonelo esivivinyiwe sokusebenza kweqembu ngaphandle kwemingcele yamazwe nangaphandle kokuvumelana ngesikhathi, into abafundi bezekhompyutha bamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba abayidingayo ukwakha ikhono lobuchwepheshe nelokuxhumana namasiko ahlukene bengasuki ekhaya.

arXiv (accepted, IEEE Frontiers in Education 2026) · Working paper (arXiv preprint, accepted IEEE FIE 2026)

entry.title: Copenhagen university appoints an anthropologist, not a computer scientist, to lead its AI strategy
entry.summary:
I-University of Copenhagen iqokile isazi sesayensi yokuziphatha kwabantu (anthropologist) Morten Axel Pedersen njengosekela-mphathi wokuqala we-AI, ikhethe isifundiswa esifunda ukuthi abantu bazenza kanjani ngempela kunosokhompyutha ukuba ahole isu lemali eyizigidi eziyi-110 zemali yaseDenmark elimbozwa ihhovisi le-AI, ithimba elikhethekile, amalebhu kanye ne-AI ekhiqizayo eyenziwe ngokukhethekile. UPedersen, owagcina eqondise i-Centre for Social Data Science yenyuvesi, uhlela ukubuyekeza zonke izifundo enyuvesini ngaphakathi konyaka ukuze acabanga ukuthi i-AI kufanele isetshenziswe kanjani kuyinye yazo, futhi uchaza isikhundla sakhe seminyaka emithathu njengesiseko sesikhashana esizobuye sichithwe lapho izifundo zinezawo imithetho.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-insika 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola nokuziphatha okuhle, ukukhetha kwase-Copenhagen kuveza ukuthi indlela abafundi nabasebenzi bawasebenzisa ngempela ngayo i-AI, hhayi lokho inqubomgomo ekushoyo kuphela, kuyindawo efanele yokuqalisa ukuguqulwa kokufundisa nokuhlola; i-Wits AHEAD ikubona njengobufakazi bokuthi ukulawulwa kwe-AI ekilasini kumbuzo womuntu njengoba kuyimbuzo yobuchwepheshe.

Times Higher Education (Seher Asaf) · Established press profile

entry.title: UK research network to redo grant review after AI triage rejected half of proposals
entry.summary:
I-CRANE, inethiwekhi yocwaningo lokuvikeleka kwe-cyber e-UK ebambelwe e-University of Oxford futhi isekelwa i-UK Research and Innovation, ivumile ukuphinda yenze ukubuyekeza kwayo kwesibizo sesicelo sezimali ngemuva kokuba inqubo ye-AI triage yenqabe cishe iningxenye ye-179 wezicelo eyazitholile ngaphambi kokuba noyedwa umuntu obuyekeza acabange kuzo. Inethiwekhi ithe isebenzisa izinhlelo ezivalekile futhi eziphephile esikhundleni samasevisi e-AI omphakathi futhi ukuthi akukho idatha yesicelo eyayizosetshenziswa ukuqeqesha imodeli, futhi imise okwesikhashana iminikelo yezimali eyake ihlinzekwa ngenkathi sonke isicelo esikhishwe ngaphandle sibuyekezwa kabusha iphaneli yayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-insika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, lesi senzakalo siyisiyalo ukuthi ukwenza isizinda sokuxhaswa kocwaningo ngokuzenzakalela ngaphandle kokuveza nendlela yokuphikisa kungavimba umsebenzi osemthethweni ngaphambi kokuba umuntu awufunde; i-Wits AHEAD ikhombisa ukubuyekezwa kabusha, hhayi iphutha lodwa, njengezinga leziko lonke elisebenzisa i-AI ekubuyekezweni okubucayi okufanele libambeke kulo.

Times Higher Education (Frances Jones) · Established press investigation

entry.title: Tshwane University of Technology dialogue presses South Africa to move from AI strategy to implementation
entry.summary:
I-Institute for the Future of Work ye-Tshwane University of Technology ibambe i-Future of Work Dialogue yayo yesihlanu yanyaka ePitoli, ihlanganisa uhulumeni, ongoti bezemfundo nabezimboni ngaphansi kwesihloko sokuqhubela phambili ikusasa elijulile le-Afrika ngokusetshenziswa kwe-AI. Umqondisi osezingeni eliphezulu Tseliso Mohlomi uphikise ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika kudingeka idlulele ekuqaleni kokusetshenziswa kwe-AI esikhundleni sokuba ibambelele esipikweni nenhlolokhono, eqamba ukuvikeleka kwe-cyber, ukusetshenziswa kwe-cloud computing, ukufunda nokuqonda i-AI kanye nobunjiniyela bedatha njengamakhono okudingeka manje. Izingxoxo zivuselele isiphakamiso, esingakagculisi kusukela emhlanganweni wonyaka odlule, se-National AI Implementation Council ezohlanganisa uhulumeni, amanyuvesi nabezimboni ukuze bafinyelele imiphumela engakalwa.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-insika 4, i-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, ukugcizelela kwezingxoxo ekusetshenzisweni kunokucubungula kwenqubomgomo kuhambisana ngqo nokukhathazeka kwe-Wits AHEAD ukuthi amadokhumenti ezinqubomgomo uwodwa awadali amathuba omsebenzi; ikomidi elihlanganisayo elifana nalelo elihlongozwayo yisakhiwo lapho ukuqeqeshwa kwamanyuvesi kungafaniswa khona nezidingo zamakhono eziqanjiwe futhi ezishintsha ngokushesha.

iAfrica.com (Thebe Mabanga, Inside Education) · Established press report on a university-hosted policy dialogue

entry.title: Liberia advances a national education data system to inform real-time decisions
entry.summary:
Umnyango Wezemfundo wase-Liberia uphothule izingxoxo zokubonisana kuzwelonke ngenqubomgomo entsha ye-Education Management Information System (EMIS), esekelwa i-African Union ngesikhungo sayo, i-Pan-African Institute for Education and Development. USekela-Ngqongqoshe Thomas Momo Parker uthe idatha ethembekile futhi ebuyekezwa ngesikhathi iyadingeka ekuhleleni, ekubhajetini nasekuthatheni izinqumo, njengoba umnyango uqala kabusha i-Annual School Census futhi wethula izincwajana zokugcina amarekhodi ezikole ngokomthetho. Izingxoxo, ezabanjelwa eMonrovia ne-European Union, i-UNESCO, i-Plan International Liberia kanye ne-UNICEF, zabonisa izikhala ekuphathweni kwedatha, ezingqalasizindeni, emandleni obuchwepheshe nasekuxhaseni ngezimali.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ku-insika 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha nedatha yezinhlelo zemfundo nokuthathwa kwezinqumo, inyathelo lase-Liberia libonisa ukuthi isakhiwo sedatha sikazwelonke, hhayi izindlela zekhompyutha kuphela, kuyisisekelo esidingwa yinoma iyiphi inhlelo yomhlaba waseNingizimu Yomhlaba ngaphambi kokuthi amathuluzi okubikezela noma amadeshibhodi athenjwe; i-Wits AHEAD ilandelela loku kokusisekelo njengesimo esidingekayo sokuhlaziywa ekucwaningwa kwakho kwezinye izindawo.

African Newspage (Ministry of Education, Republic of Liberia) · National government announcement

entry.title: A college president on harnessing AI in education without cutting corners
entry.summary:
Umongameli we-Colby College, u-David Greene, utshela i-ABC News ukuthi leli kolishi lase-Melika lezifundo ze-liberal arts lisebenzisa kanjani ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI) ekufundiseni nasekufundeni ngendlela ayichaza njengenokuziphatha okuhle futhi engasebenzisi izindlela ezinqamulelayo. Kuyindaba emfushane, exoxwa ngumuntu ozibonele ngqo, yobuholi bezikhungo mayelana ne-AI.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kunsika 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ikhombisa umholi wenyuvesi ophatha i-AI njengento okufanele ilolongwe ngamabomu kunokuba ilawulwe ngokuqapha nje kuphela, okuwumbono i-Wits AHEAD ewukhuthazayo emanyuvesi ase-Afrika.

ABC News · ABC News (US national broadcaster)

entry.title: What should a university be in the age of AI? SABC News on the first Times Higher Education summit in Africa
entry.summary:
Ngaphambi kwe-Times Higher Education World Academic Summit, esingathwe yi-University of Cape Town kusukela zingama-29 kuMandulo kuya ku-1 kuMfumfu, okuyingqungquthela yokuqala ebanjelwe emhlabathini wase-Afrika, i-SABC News ibuza ukuthi inyuvesi kufanele ibukeke kanjani njengoba i-AI iguqula indlela abantu abasebenza ngayo, abafunda ngayo nabakha ngayo ulwazi. IPhini likaShansela Wezocwaningo Nokuxhumana Namazwe Ngamazwe e-UCT, uSolwazi Thokozani Majozi, uxoxa ngesihloko sengqungquthela, "Knowledge, justice and futures: Universities in the age of intelligence", kanye neqhaza lamanyuvesi elingaphezu kokukhiqiza abathweswe iziqu.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kunsika 4, amakhono abathweswe iziqu nokwedlulela kwabo emsebenzini, umbuzo wengqungquthela wokuthi amanyuvesi akweletwa yini abathweswe iziqu nomphakathi njengoba i-AI iguqula umsebenzi ngumbuzo weqembu uqobo, manje obuzwa esiteji saseNingizimu Afrika.

SABC News · SABC News (public broadcaster)

entry.title: African scholarship is building a decolonial agenda for AI in university classrooms, systematic review finds
entry.summary:
Ukubuyekezwa okuhlelekile ephephabhukwini le-Trends in Higher Education kuhlaziya izifundo ezingu-25 kusukela ngo-2010 kuya ku-2025 mayelana nokuqeda ubukoloni (decoloniality), ubuhlakani bokwenziwa namakilasi asenyuvesi emfundweni ephakeme yase-Afrika. Ukushicilelwa kwashesha ngemva kuka-2020 kugxile ezindikimbeni ezintathu, ukungabi nabulungiswa kolwazi kanye nekharikhulamu, ubukoloni be-algorithm kanye nokuthathwa kwedatha ngokuxhaphaza, kanye nezinguquko ekufundiseni ezidingwa yi-AI ekhiqizayo, kanti ucwaningo lugxile kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, kukhona nomsebenzi osafufusa wezwekazi lonke lase-Afrika mayelana ne-AI yezilimi zase-Afrika. Ababhali bathola ukuthi kunohlelo locwaningo lwe-AI olugxile ekuqedeni ubukoloni oluhambisanayo oluyakheka, kodwa okwamanje bukhona ubufakazi obumbalwa obusekelwe ocwaningweni lwasensimini.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kunsika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela nenqubomgomo, kuveza imibuzo yokuthi ulwazi lukabani nezilimi zikabani i-AI ezingenisa emakilasini ase-Afrika, futhi kukhombisa ukuthi isisekelo sobufakazi sisencane kangakanani, igebe ucwaningo lwe-Wits School of Education olungasiza ukulivala.

Trends in Higher Education (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed systematic review

entry.title: AI emerges as a distinct part of the student academic experience in a survey of 2,403 Bolivian undergraduates
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwabafundi beziqu zokuqala abangu-2,403 enyuvesi ezimele e-Bolivia, olushicilelwe ephephabhukwini le-Education Sciences, luqinisekisa ukuthembeka kohlu lwemibuzo olunezinto ezingu-31 mayelana nokuhlangenwe nakho kwezemfundo, futhi luthola ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekufundeni kwabo, njengoba kubikwa ngabafundi, kuyisici esihlukile eceleni kokuzibandakanya, ukucabanga okuhlaziyayo, izinga lokufundisa nokuzinikela. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI okubikiwe kwakuhlobene kahle nokuzibandakanya kwezemfundo kanye namakhono okuxhumana, okuziphatha nokucabanga okuhlaziyayo; ababhali bagcizelela ukuthi leli thuluzi likala imibono, hhayi imiphumela yokufunda.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kunsika 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ithuluzi eliqinisekisiwe lamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba elibheka ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI njengengxenye yendlela abafundi abayizwa ngayo inyuvesi liyithuluzi eliwusizo iqembu elingalivumelanisa nezinhlolovo zabafundi zaseNingizimu Afrika, kanye nesixwayiso sababhali sokuthi likala imibono, hhayi ukufunda.

Education Sciences (MDPI) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Oxford let OpenAI train AI models on Bodleian Library texts, the Guardian reports
entry.summary:
Amadokumenti angaphakathi i-Guardian ewathole abonisa ukuthi i-University of Oxford ivumele i-OpenAI ukwenza i-digitise yezincwadi zomlando ze-Bodleian Library yayo, kuhlanganise ne-125,000 ye-scan yama-thesis emidwebo yabadokotela yekhulu le-19 kanye le-20 kanye ne-10,000 ye-"broadside ballads" yesikhathi sase-Tudor, ukusiza ukuqeqesha amamodeli ayo e-AI. Ubambiswano lwe-Oxford ne-OpenAI, olumenyezelwe ngo-2025, lwethulwa njengephrojekthi yokwandisa ukufinyelela kumbhalo oyivelakancane; akuvezwanga ukuthi lezi scan zizosetshenziselwa idatha yokuqeqesha ye-OpenAI. Amaminithi aphakathi abonisa ukuthi amalungu ekomidi lokuphatha abekazwelana ngengcuphe yesithunzi kanye nezindleko zamandla ze-AI, kuyilapho i-Oxford ithi lo mbhalo mncane ngesilinganiso, awuselona copyright, futhi uzoshicilelwa online emasontweni ezayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yesithupha, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha kanye nenqubomgomo, lesi senzakalo siyisixwayiso kunyuvesi noma iphi, e-Afrika esezansi kweSahara noma e-Oxford, evumela inkampani ye-AI ukuphatha amafayela noma idatha yayo: ngaphandle kokuvezwa obala kuphela ukuthi umbhalo uzosetshenziswa kanjani, iphrojekthi yangempela yokufinyelela ingabukeka, uma kubhekwa emuva, njengesivumelwano esifihliwe sokunikeza idatha, okuyiyona gebe lokungaveli obala i-Wits AHEAD ecela izikhungo ukuvala ngaphambi kokusayina.

The Guardian (Ethan Penny and Dan Milmo) · Established press investigation

entry.title: University of Ghana approves an AI policy and a compulsory digital literacy course for every student
entry.summary:
Ikhansela le-University of Ghana ligunyaze inqubomgomo ye-AI esebenza enyuvesi yonke, eyakhiwe ngemva kocwaningo lwangaphakathi olwathola izikhala ekuqeqeshweni, ukufinyelela okulinganiselweyo ezinsizeni ze-AI, kanye nokukhathazeka ngokunemba, ubuqotho bezemfundo kanye nokuziphatha. Ekumemezela emcimbini wokwethweswa iziqu e-Accra, lapho abafundi abangu-1,884 bathweswa iziqu, isekelamengameli, uSolwazi Nana Aba Appiah Amfo, wathi inyuvesi izophinde idinge kuwo wonke umfundi, kusukela onyakeni wezemfundo olandelayo, ukuthatha isifundo esisha esiphoqelelekile sokufunda ngobuchwepheshe kanye ne-AI esebenzayo, ehambisana nenqubomgomo ehlukene yokufundisa nokufunda.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yokuqala, i-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, isibonelo senyuvesi kahulumeni edlulela kusuka kumadokumenti abonisa indlela kuya esifundweni esiphoqelelekile sokufunda ulwazi lwe-AI kuwo wonke umfundi othweswa iziqu, sisekelwe kubufakazi bayo uqobo bezindawo abafundi nabasebenzi ababhekana nazo izinkinga, kuyilona hlobo lwesabelo esihlelekile futhi esisebenza kukhamphasi yonke i-Wits AHEAD ekufunayo kulo lonke izwekazi, kunezinqubomgomo ezihlala emaphepheni kuphela.

University of Ghana (policy document); Ghanaian Times · University policy document

entry.title: OECD finds generative AI use nearly universal in higher education but only one in five institutions has a formal policy
entry.summary:
Umbiko we-OECD, othi "Policies supporting responsible and systematic GenAI adoption in higher education", oshicilelwe kuchungechunge lwe-OECD Education Spotlights, uthola ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekhiqizayo kubafundi benyuvesi kuphenduke kuba yinto ejwayelekile cishe emhlabeni wonke, kukhuphuke kusuka ku-66% yabafundi baseBrithani ngo-2024 kuya ku-95% ngo-2026, kanti ama-86% abafundi bakusebenzisa kucwaningo olwenziwe emazweni angu-16. Nokho, ama-19% kuphela ezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme emhlabeni jikelele ezinenqubomgomo esemthethweni ye-AI ekhiqizayo ngo-2025, nakuba ama-42% ayengaphezulu ayisabhalwa, futhi ama-17% kuphela abasebenzi bezemfundo ephakeme emhlabeni jikelele ababalwa njengabasebenzisi abaphezulu noma ongoti.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yesithupha, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha kanye nenqubomgomo, igebe elikalwa yi-OECD, phakathi kokusetshenziswa kwansuku zonke okucishe kube emhlabeni wonke kanye nokulawulwa okusemthethweni kunyuvesi eyodwa kwezinhlanu, yilona gebe ngempela i-Wits AHEAD esungulwelwa ukusiza ukuvala, kanye nesikhuthazo sokuthi ukwamukela amathuluzi e-AI nokuwalawula ngokuzibophezela kumisebenzi emibili eyahlukene ingqikithi, amanyuvesi amaningi angakawuqedi noma munye wayo.

University World News (Karen MacGregor), reporting an OECD report · Intergovernmental research report, reported by established press

entry.title: African universities urged to collaborate and use AI responsibly, Times Higher Education summit hears
entry.summary:
Ekhulumeni e-Times Higher Education World Academic Summit eCape Town, umphathi wokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi wenhlangano lezwe i-sub-Saharan Africa, uMosebjadi Petje, ubize amanyuvesi ase-Afrika ukuthi abelane ngezinsiza zocwaningo nobuchwepheshe ukubhekana nezinselelo ezifanayo njengoshintsho lwesimo sezulu nokuntuleka kwemisebenzi yentsha, futhi ukuthi babhekane ne-AI "ngokuzibophezela" kunokuyenqaba. Uphinde wakhuthaza izikhungo ukuthi zisebenzise idatha yazo siqu ukuthatha izinqumo zokuphatha hhayi kuphela ukubonwa ohlwini, ekhuluma kubameleli bamanyuvesi angaba ngu-55 ase-sub-Saharan Africa abonakala ohlwini lwe-Times Higher Education World University Rankings.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yesithupha, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, isicelo esivela ngqo embonini yamanyuvesi ase-Afrika sokuthi kwabelwane ngezinsiza kanye nokusetshenziswa kwe-AI okunokuzibophezela, kunokuba kulandelwe imithetho evela kwamanye amazwe, kuhambisana ngqo nendlela yokubambisana eholwa yi-Afrika ye-Wits AHEAD ekuphathweni kwe-AI emfundweni ephakeme.

Channel Africa (SABC international service) · Established broadcaster

entry.title: US unemployment rate for university graduates falls to 2.5%, lowest of any education group, official data show
entry.summary:
I-United States Bureau of Labor Statistics ibika ukuthi izinga lokuntuleka kwemisebenzi kwabantu abane-degree noma okuphezulu lehlile laba ngu-2.5% ngoSepthemba 2026, kusuka ku-2.7% ngo-Agasti, lihlala liphansi kakhulu kunawo wonke amazinga emfundo lehhovisi elihlahlobayo. Umbiko, i-USDL-26-1549, ubuye ubonise ukuthi ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kwabasebenzi abangenayo ikhono lenyuvesi kusahamba amaphesenti ambalwa ngaphezulu kuleyo nyanga.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yesine, i-AI, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, idatha esemthethweni yase-US ekhombisa igebe lokuntuleka kwemisebenzi liphinde liqhubeke ngokubanzi kubantu abane-degree, iyisikhumbuzo sokuthi, nakuba i-AI iguqula ukuqashwa kwabaqala umsebenzi emhlabeni wonke, iziqu zenyuvesi zisalethela inzuzo encane kodwa ebalwayo emsebenzini, okuyinto ucwaningo lwe-Wits AHEAD lokuqasheka oluhlola yona emazweni aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment Situation News Release (September 2026) · National statistics office

entry.title: UCT vice-chancellor says all students will be trained to use AI, not banned from it
entry.summary:
Ekhulumeni e-Times Higher Education World Academic Summit eCape Town, isekelamengameli we-University of Cape Town, uSolwazi Mosa Moshabela, uthe inyuvesi isidlulele ekuvinjelweni kokusetshenziswa kwe-AI ekhiqizayo iye ekuqeqesheni bonke abafundi ukuthi bayisebenzise ngokuzibophezela, emazingeni ahlukene. I-UCT iyekile ukuthembela ezinsizeni zokuhlonza i-AI ukuqapha umsebenzi wabafundi, manje ibheka i-AI, ngamazwi akhe uqobo, njenge "umlingani kuhlelo lokufundisa nokufunda". Inyuvesi iphinde isebenza ukwenza izinsiza ze-AI zitholakale ngale kwekhampasi, ngoba izinsiza zezohwebo zisalokhu zibiza kakhulu kumiphakathi eminingi kulo mazwekazi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yokuqala, i-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ukudlulela kusuka ekuqapheni ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI kuya ekuqeqesheni bonke abafundi kuwuphawu olucacile kakhulu ukuthi inyuvesi enkulu yaseNingizimu Yomhlaba ibheka ukufunda nokuqonda i-AI njengekhono eliyisisekelo labathweswe iziqu, hhayi inkinga yesiyalo, isiqondiso i-Wits AHEAD esisebenzela khona ocwaningweni lwayo kuhlolwa nokwethembeka.

University of Cape Town News (story by Niémah Davids) · University announcement

entry.title: AI governance becomes higher education's top technology priority for the first time, EDUCAUSE survey finds
entry.summary:
I-EDUCAUSE, inhlangano yezobuchwepheshe bemfundo ephakeme yase-United States ne-Canada, ibika ukuthi uphenyo lwayo lwe-2027 Top 10 IT Issues, olwenziwe kubaphathi bobuchwepheshe abangu-882, lubeke okokuqala ngqa umbuzo wokuthi i-AI ilethela inzuzo yangempela kuphi esicongweni sohlu, ingena esikhundleni sokuvikelwa kobuchwepheshe. Ukuklama izakhiwo ze-AI ezilandela inqubo yokusungula okunembeza kanye nokwakha uhlelo oluqinile lokuphathwa kwedatha nakho kube ingxenye yalezi eziyishumi eziphezulu, okuvela ebunzulwini obukhulu kunakuqala obuke labelwa kuleli phenyo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yesithupha, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ukulingana kanye nenqubomgomo, umphumela ukhombisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwe-AI kusesesikhundleni esikhulu sombuzo wobuchwepheshe emfundweni ephakeme emazweni aseNyakatho nakwaseNingizimu Yomhlaba, inguquko i-Wits AHEAD esisebenzela khona ngqo ngenqubomgomo yayo.

EDUCAUSE 2027 Top 10 IT Issues (via Campus Technology) · Higher education technology association survey

entry.title: University of Pretoria vice-chancellor says graduates need AI fluency and power skills, not just a degree, to find work
entry.summary:
Ebhala ku-Daily Maverick, isekela-shansela yeNyuvesi yasePitoli, uSolwazi Francis Petersen, uthi ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi kwabathweswe iziqu eNingizimu Afrika kuqhubeka ngesikhathi esifanayo nokushoda kwamakhono emiphakathi yabaqashi ngenxa yokuthi amanyuvesi asafundisa abafundi ngomsebenzi owodwa wokuqala kunokubafundisa izinguquko zomsebenzi impilo yabo yonke. Uthi abaqashi manje balindele abathweswe iziqu abakwazi ukusebenzisa i-AI ngokuzimisela, ndawonye nokuxhumana, ukubambisana nokucabanga okujulile, futhi ucela ukuthuthukiswa kwamathuba okuqeqeshwa emsebenzini, ukufunda okuhlanganiswe nomsebenzi kanye nokusekelwa kobungenieli kuzo zonke izifundo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yesine, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye nezinguquko ezinobulungiswa, isekela-shansela yaseNingizimu Afrika iqamba ukwaziswa nge-AI njengekhono eliyisisekelo lokuqasheka, kanye namakhono okuziphatha abaqashi abawafuna nakhu, kuqinisa icala lomsebenzi weWits AHEAD lokuxhumanisa ukuhlaziywa, uhlelo lwezifundo kanye nemiphumela yabathweswe iziqu.

Daily Maverick (Professor Francis Petersen, Vice-Chancellor, University of Pretoria) · University vice-chancellor opinion article, established press

entry.title: Bangladeshi university students show moderate knowledge but mixed practice on AI-assisted plagiarism, study finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwabafundi abangu-386 emanyuvesi aphethwe ngumbuso nawazimele e-Bangladesh, olushicilelwe ephephabhukwini le-AI and Ethics, luthola ulwazi oluphakathi nendawo kanye nokwenza okungahambisani kahle mayelana ne-AI-giarism, okokusebenzisa amathuluzi e-AI ekhiqizayo ukukhiqiza umsebenzi owethulwa ngathi ngumsebenzi womfundi ngqo, nakuba ukuziphatha ngokumelene nokweqa kwemigomo yocwaningo kuhle ngesikhathi esiningi. Ukuziphatha kwehlukahlukana ngokuya ngohlobo lwenyuvesi, isimo sokuhlala, ukuhlangenwe nakho kokushicilela kanye nesifundo, kanti abafundi abaqeqeshiwe ekubhaleni kwezifundo bababika ukwenza okungcono.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yokuqala, i-AI ekhiqizayo emfundweni ephakeme, ukuhlolwa nokuziphatha okuhle, ukutholakala kokuthi ukuziphatha okuhle akuqinisekisi ukwenza okuhle kukhumbuza ukuthi ulwazi mayelana ne-AI, hhayi inqubomgomo kuphela, yilona oluvikela ubuqotho bokuhlolwa, umbuzo ophethe ngokufanayo kubalingani be-Wits AHEAD baseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

AI and Ethics (Noakhali Science and Technology University) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Lisbon university combines early-warning alerts with compulsory AI literacy to protect first-year students, study finds
entry.summary:
Ucwaningo lwesikhungo sonke se-Iscte, iNyuvesi Yesifunda saseLisbon, olushicilelwe ephephabhukwini le-Education Sciences, luchaza iminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye lokuhlanganisa uhlelo lwesexwayiso sangaphambili olusekelwe emithethweni oluphawula abafundi bonyaka wokuqala abasengozini, nesifundo esibucayi se-AI esiyimpoqo kamu elinye nesikhethwayo kwelinye. Ababhali babika ukuthi ingozi yezemfundo igxile emaqenjini angabonakala, nokuthi isisekelo esivamile solwazi lwe-AI singafezeka, kodwa ukusekelwa kufinyelela kubafundi abambalwa kuphela kulabo abaphawuliwe, kanti amamodeli abikezelayo aqeqeshelwe kwiqembu elilodwa alisebenzi kahle kwelilandelayo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kusinsika yesibili, ukuhlaziywa okubikezelayo kwempumelelo yabafundi, ukugcinwa kwabafundi kanye nesexwayiso sangaphambili, ukutholakala kwangempela, kokuthi ukusekelwa nokubikezela kunemikhawulo yangempela, kuyisiyalo esiwusizo ku-Wits AHEAD njengoba kucabangela amathuluzi ayo wesexwayiso sangaphambili kanye nezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuthi asebenze.

Education Sciences (Iscte - University Institute of Lisbon) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: OECD data show graduate unemployment rising for the first time since its records began
entry.summary:
Umbiko we-OECD othi Education at a Glance 2026, owethulwa ngomhla zingama-29 kuMandulo 2026, uthole ukuthi ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi phakathi kwabasha abaneminyaka ewu-25 kuya kwengama-34 abane-degree yasenyuvesi kukhuphuke ngama-0.4 wamaphesenti emazweni angamalungu phakathi kuka-2023 no-2025, kuyilapho ukuntuleka kwemisebenzi phakathi kwabanemfundo yamabanga aphezulu kuphela kwehla ngama-0.2 wamaphesenti, okunciphisa igebe elivamile, okuwukuphenduka kokuqala okunjalo selokhu lolu cwaningo lwaqalwa ngo-2000. INingizimu Korea ikhombisa lesi simo ngokucacile: ama-71.1% abantu baseNingizimu Korea abaneminyaka ewu-25 kuya kwengama-34 banesiqu semfundo ephakeme, okungaphezulu kakhulu kwesilinganiso se-OECD esingama-47.5%, kodwa izinga lemisebenzi labathweswe iziqu elingama-80.1% lingaphansi kwesilinganiso se-OECD esingama-86%.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 4 ka-Wits AHEAD, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, lokhu kuwuphawu olucacile kakhulu kuze kube manje emazweni e-OECD lokuthi inzuzo yeziqu emsebenzini iyancipha ngesikhathi i-AI iguqula imisebenzi yokuqala, okuyitrendi okufanele i-Wits AHEAD iyilandelele ngokuqhathanisa nedatha yayo yokuthi abathweswe iziqu baseNingizimu Afrika bayaphi.

OECD, Education at a Glance 2026 (via UPI) · Intergovernmental body data, reported by an international wire service

entry.title: Côte d'Ivoire launches UNESCO-backed AI training for 3,000 vocational education teachers
entry.summary:
UNgqongqoshe Owamele Wezemfundo Yobuchwepheshe Nokuqeqeshwa Kwemisebenzi wase-Cote d'Ivoire, uJean-Louis Moulot, uqale uhlelo ngomhla zingama-25 kuMandulo 2026 lokuqeqesha othisha abayizi-3,000, ababonisi bezemfundo kanye nabaphathi bezemfundo yobuchwepheshe nokuqeqeshwa kwemisebenzi mayelana nobuhlakani bokwenziwa, ngosizo lobuchwepheshe lwe-UNESCO. Isigaba sokuqala siqala zingama-1 kuMfumfu size siphele zingama-30 kuZibandlela 2026, siqeqesha othisha abayi-1,000 e-Abidjan ngezisekelo ze-AI, ukusetshenziswa kwemfundo, izindlela zokuhlola, ukuziphatha okuhle kanye nokuphepha kwedatha, ngaphambi kokuthi uhlelo luhlolwe ukuze lwandiswe ezweni lonke.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 3 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwi-STEM nasekufundiseni othisha, lolu uhlelo olungavamile oluholwa uhulumeni futhi lusekelwa i-UNESCO, oluqeqesha abaqeqeshi bothisha ngokwabo kungekhona abafundi babo kuphela, uhlobo i-Wits AHEAD engalusebenzisa emsebenzini wayo namakolishi aseNingizimu Afrika aFundisa Ubuchwepheshe Nokuqeqeshwa Kwemisebenzi.

TrendsnAfrica · Government programme launch with UNESCO technical support, reported by regional press

entry.title: Ghana commits to train 100,000 TVET facilitators in AI under new UNESCO and Microsoft partnership
entry.summary:
Isikhungo sase-Ghana Sokufundisa Ngobuchwepheshe Nemisebenzi (TVET) sisayine isivumelwano ne-UNESCO, i-KPMG ne-Microsoft ngomhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 2026, ukufundisa okungenani othisha bakwa-TVET abayizinkulungwane ezilikhulu kwi-AI nekhono ledijithali ngaphansi kohlelo i-AI EmpowerED. Umphathi we-TVET Service, uDkt Eric Kofi Adzroe, uthe lobu bambiswano buveza uguquko oluya kuhlelo elihambisana nembonakalo yeziko, eliqhutshwa ubuchwepheshe futhi ligxile kumiphumela, kanti ummeleli we-UNESCO e-Ghana, uEdmond Moukala, usayine isivumelwano egameni lenhlangano.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 4 ka-Wits AHEAD, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye noguquko olunobulungiswa, ukuhlomisa othisha bakwa-TVET ngamakhono e-AI ngesilinganiso esinje kungaguqula indlela isizukulwane sonke sababazi nabasebenzi bobuchwepheshe base-Afrika engena ngayo emakethe yemisebenzi esiguqulwe i-AI, isibonelo i-Wits AHEAD esilandela ukuthola izifundo ezisebenza emkhakhani wase-South Africa we-TVET.

Graphic Online · National press, government partnership announcement

entry.title: US learning platform data shows AI tools trail far behind other classroom technology
entry.summary:
Umbiko omusha we-EdTech Top 40 we-Instructure, osekelwe kudatha engenamagama yabasebenzisi abayizigidi ezingu-19.5 benkundla yokufunda ye-Canvas phakathi kukaMandulo 2025 noMbasa 2026, uthole ukuthi i-Google Gemini, ithuluzi le-AI elisetshenziswa kakhulu, lifinyelele kuphela kubasebenzisi abangu-87,788 ezikhungweni ezingu-211, futhi alifinyelelanga nakwizindawo ezingu-100 eziphezulu zamathuluzi ahlanganisiwe. Amathuluzi asezinzile njengo-McGraw Hill, onabasebenzisi abayizigidi ezingu-11.3, kanye nokuhlolwa kwezifundo kwe-Watermark ne-Zoom, asalokhu esetshenziswa kakhulu kunakho konke. Isekela likamongameli we-Instructure, uRyan Lufkin, uthe amanyuvesi asayina izivumelwano ze-AI ezimboza yonke inyuvesi kodwa engakayifaki le mithuluzi ezifundweni zansuku zonke.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 1 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, igebe eliphakathi kwamalayisense e-AI athengwa izikhungo nokusetshenziswa kwangempela ekilasini yisexwayiso i-Wits AHEAD esiyilandelayo eduze: ukuthenga ukufinyelela emathuluzini e-AI akufani nokuwafaka ekufundiseni nasekuhloleni, okuxhumana ngqo nomsebenzi weqembu mayelana nokusetshenziswa okungokoqobo.

Inside Higher Ed · Established press report on industry usage data

entry.title: UNESCO programme trains over 100 rural teachers and principals across China and Southeast Asia in AI and STEM
entry.summary:
I-UNESCO ibike ngomhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 2026 ukuthi uHlelo Lwayo Lokuthuthukisa Amakhono Othisha Nabaphathi e-China ne-Southeast Asia, olubanjwe eBeijing kusukela zi-17 kuya zi-23 kuNcwaba 2026 ngaphansi kwesihloko esithi 'I-STEM ne-AI: Ukunika Amandla Othisha Basemakhaya Ngoguquko Ledijithali', luhlanganise abenzi bezinqubomgomo zemfundo abangaphezu kwekhulu, abaphathi bezikole, othisha kanye nochwepheshe abavela e-China nasemazweni ase-Southeast Asia. Luhlelwe ndawonye ne-International Research and Training Centre for Rural Education ye-UNESCO, i-SEAMEO RECSAM, iSihlalo se-UNESCO Sobuhlakani Bokwenziwa Kwimfundo e-Beijing Normal University kanye ne-OECD, uhlelo belugxile ekusebenziseni i-AI nokufundisa i-STEM ukuthuthukisa ukulingana kwedijithali emiphakathini yasemakhaya engaphathwa ngokwanele. USolwazi Shahbaz Khan, umqondisi we-Hhovisi Lesifunda le-UNESCO le-East Asia, ubize i-AI 'egxile emuntwini, enokuzimela ngokokuziphatha futhi ebandakanya bonke' kwimfundo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 3 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwi-STEM nemfundo yothisha, ukugcizelela kohlelo ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasekela kodwa bungasoze bathatha indawo yothisha basemakhaya kunikeza isibonelo i-Wits AHEAD engasisebenzisa emsebenzini wayo wokulungiselela abafundisi bothisha ezingxenyeni ezingaphathwa ngokwanele zamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body

entry.title: Ethiopia's Education Ministry says AI will support, not replace, teachers as it expands digital learning
entry.summary:
UNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo wase-Ethiopia, uBerhanu Nega, uthe ngomhla zingama-29 kuMandulo 2026 ukuthi othisha ezweni lonke basekelwa ukusebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ekulungiseleleni izifundo, ukuthuthukisa okuqukethwe, ukusekela abafundi kanye nokuhlola, kanye nokudijithalaywa kwezinhlelo zolwazi lokuphathwa kwemfundo neyemfundo ephakeme yomnyango. UNgqongqoshe ugcizelele ukuthi i-AI yethulwa ukuqinisa amakhono othisha, hhayi ukubathatha isikhundla, njengengxenye yomkhankaso obanzi wokufunda okuku-inthanethi, okuxubile kanye nezincwadi ezincane, kanye nokuxhumana kwedijithali okuqinile emanyuvesini nasezikoleni. Ucele ukuthi uhlelo lwemfundo ludlule ekugcineni ngekhanda kuphela futhi lithuthukise abacabanga ngokugxekayo abangasebenza 'ndawonye nemishini'.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 1 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, kanye nensika 5, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha kwizinhlelo zemfundo, umnyango wikazwelonke ozibophezela obala ukuthi i-AI isekela othisha esikhundleni sokubathatha indawo, kanye noguquko ngesevisi yedatha, yisibonakaliso senqubomgomo i-Wits AHEAD esiyilandelayo kulo lonke elamazwe aseNingizimu Yomhlaba.

allAfrica (Ethiopian News Agency) · National press, government ministry announcement

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI solutions rather than import them, says UN scientific panel member
entry.summary:
UGirmaw Abebe Tadesse, oholela i-AI for Good Lab ye-Microsoft e-Kenya futhi angxenye ye-Independent International Scientific Panel ye-United Nations Yobuhlakani Bokwenziwa, utshele i-UN News ngesikhathi se-UN High Level Week eNew York ngomhla zingama-25 kuMandulo 2026 ukuthi amazwe ase-Afrika kufanele achaze izinkinga zawo siqu ngaphambi kokwamukela ubuchwepheshe obuklanywe kwenye indawo. Uthe ababambiqhaza, kuhlanganise izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, ohulumeni, abalingani bentuthuko kanye nezinkampani zobuchwepheshe, kufanele bahlanganise ulwazi ukwakha izixazululo ezifanele izimo zendawo kunokuphinda okwenziwe kakade, futhi waphawula ukuthi abantu abasha base-Afrika sebevele beyisidingida sokusungula, sebesebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ezinkingeni zemiphakathi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 6 ka-Wits AHEAD, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okulungile, ukulingana nenqubomgomo, umeluleki wesayensi we-United Nations obiza obala amanyuvesi njengabalingani ababalulekile ohlelweni lwe-AI oluholwa yindawo uqinisa isizathu se-Wits AHEAD sokugcizelela ucwaningo nezixazululo zase-Afrika, hhayi izinhlaka ezingenisiwe.

allAfrica (UN News) · UN News Service, intergovernmental body

entry.title: Cape Town hosts first African THE World Academic Summit as Wits and four other South African universities rise in the world rankings
entry.summary:
Ingqungquthela Yezemfundo Ephakeme Yomhlaba ye-Times Higher Education (THE) ivulwe e-University of Cape Town ngomhla zingama-30 kuMandulo 2026, okuwukuqala kwalo mcimbi ukubanjwa e-Afrika, kuhambisana nokwethulwa kohlu lwe-THE World University Rankings 2027. Manje amanyuvesi ayisihlanu aseNingizimu Afrika asezingeni lezingama-500 eziphambili emhlabeni, kuhlanganise ne-Wits esesikhundleni sango-301 kuya ku-325. I-University of Cape Town yenyukele esikhundleni sama-147 kanye nenye iyunivesithi, okuyisikhundla sayo esihle kakhulu eminyakeni eyisikhombisa. USekela-Shansela we-University of Cape Town, uMosa Moshabela, uthe inyuvesi yakhe icishe amathuluzi okuthola i-AI, igxile kunalokho ekufundiseni abafundi ukusebenzisa i-AI ngendlela efanele, kanti uNgqongqoshe Wezemfundo Ephakeme, uButi Manamela, uphawule ukuthi kwabantu abasha abayishumi baseNingizimu Afrika, abayisithupha abangasebenzi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 1 ka-Wits AHEAD, okuyi-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, isinqumo se-University of Cape Town sokuyeka ukusebenzisa amathuluzi okuthola i-AI, sikhethe kunalokho ukufundisa ukuyisebenzisa ngendlela efanele, siwuguquko enqubomgomeni yokuhlola i-Wits AHEAD esiyilandelayo kulo lonke elomkhakha wezemfundo ephakeme; ukukhuphuka kohlu lwamazinga kanye nenani lokungasebenzi elishiwo uNgqongqoshe kugcizelela ukuthi kungani i-AI, ukuhlaziywa kwedatha nekhono labathweswe iziqu kubalulekile kuwo wonke amanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika, kuhlanganise ne-Wits.

Daily Maverick · Established press

entry.title: Alliance for African Partnership meets in Dar es Salaam and puts AI skills at the centre of regional cooperation

category.term: Africa (Tanzania, hosted by the University of Dar es Salaam)

entry.summary:
I-Alliance for African Partnership, inhlangano yamanyuvesi angu-12 avela emazweni angu-10 base-Afrika eyesekelwe yi-Michigan State University, ibambe umhlangano wayo wonyaka wezi-2026 e-University of Dar es Salaam kusukela ngo-16 kuya ku-22 kuMandulo. Isekela likaShansela elibhekene Nocwaningo uNelson Boniface utshele izithunywa ukuthi amanyuvesi kumele abuyekeze uhlelo lwezifundo futhi aqeqeshe othisha ukuze abathweswe iziqu bangasali ngemuva ngenxa yobuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI), wanezela ngokuthi ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-AI manje sekuyikhono okudingeka kubo bonke abafundi, hhayi kuphela kwabesayensi yekhompyutha.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika 4, ikhono labathweswe iziqu, ukuqasheka kanye nokuguqulwa okunobulungiswa, isibizo se-Alliance sokuguqula uhlelo lwezifundo nokuqeqesha othisha emazweni angu-10 ase-Afrika sivumelana nombono ka-Wits AHEAD wokufaka ukwazi i-AI kuzo zonke izifundo, hhayi kuphela kwe-STEM, ukuze abathweswe iziqu base-Afrika baqhubeke beqashekile.

entry.title: Morgan State University wins 10 million dollar federal grant to build a trusted AI research institute
entry.summary:
I-Morgan State University, inyuvesi enomlando wabantu abaMnyama eBaltimore, ithole u-10 million wamadola kusukela kuhulumeni wase-United States ukuze isungule i-Institute for Trusted Autonomous Networks, ebizwa nge-TITAN, kanti lokhu kumenyezelwe osomthetho baseMelika uChris Van Hollen no-Angela Alsobrooks ngomhla ziyi-16 kuMandulo 2026. Lolu xhaso lweminyaka emihlanu luxhasa ucwaningo kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabafundi be-PhD kwezobuhlakani bokwenziwa (i-AI), ukuphepha kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuphepha okuthuthukiswe nge-quantum, futhi luhloswe ukusiza i-Morgan State ukuba ifinyelele izinga eliphezulu kakhulu emanyuvesi ocwaningo aseMelika.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Ngokuqondene nensika yesi-3, i-AI kanye nokuhlaziywa kwedatha kwezifundo ze-STEM nasekuqeqeshweni kothisha, ukugxila kwe-TITAN ekuqeqesheni abacwaningi be-PhD enyuvesini enomlando wabantu abaMnyama kubonisa indlela uxhaso oluqondiswe locwaningo lwe-AI olungakwazi ukwandisa ngayo ukuthi ubani oholayo kulolu cwaningo, okuwumbuzo iWits AHEAD ewulandelayo mayelana nokulingana kwe-STEM emhlabeni wonke.

CBS News Baltimore · Established press

entry.title: MIT trains faculty from other universities to teach AI across disciplines
entry.summary:
I-Stephen A. Schwarzman College of Computing yase-MIT ihlolisise ishopi eliyisonto elilodwa elifundisa othisha bezinye izikhungo ukuba bafundise ubuhlakani bokwenziwa nokufunda komshini ngaphakathi kwezifundo zabo, kususela ezinsizeni ze-kosi ye-MIT ethi 'Modelling with Machine Learning'. Ishopi lokuqala ngoJulayi 2026 lahlanganisa abafundisi abangu-19 abavela ezikhungweni eziyisikhombisa, okuhlanganisa i-Allen University, i-Babson College, i-Brandeis University kanye ne-University of Massachusetts Lowell, kufundiswa abafundisi be-MIT abangaphezu kwesithupha ngezindaba zezimali, isayensi yamakhompuyutha nokusimama.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 3, i-AI nokuhlaziywa kwedatha ku-STEM nasekufundeni othisha, leli shopi lixazulula inkinga iWits AHEAD nayo ebhekene nayo: othisha abangaphandle kwesayensi yamakhompuyutha badinga uqeqesho lwangempela ngaphambi kokuba bakwazi ukufundisa ngokuthembekile ukwazi nge-AI ngaphakathi kwezifundo zabo.

MIT News · University announcement

entry.title: UNESCO survey finds most Latin American and Caribbean universities use AI, but few have a strategy
entry.summary:
I-International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC) ye-UNESCO, ibambisene ne-United Nations University Institute for the Advanced Study of Sustainability, ihlole izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme ezingu-200 emazweni angu-19 futhi yashicilela imiphumela yayo ngo-8 Septhemba 2026, ngesikhathi se-Digital Learning Week ye-UNESCO. Kutholakele ukuthi amaphesenti angu-87 ezikhungo asesebenzisa i-AI kungenani engxenyeni eyodwa yomsebenzi wazo, ikakhulukazi ekufundiseni, kodwa amaphesenti angu-26 kuphela anohlelo lwe-AI olusemthethweni. Iningi lezinhlelo ze-AI liqala kothisha, kubacwaningi noma kubafundi ngokwabo, hhayi kubaholi bezikhungo.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 6, i-AI enokuzibophezela, ukuziphatha okuhle, ubulungisa nenqubomgomo, lo mgamu phakathi kokusetshenziswa kwe-AI okucishe kufike kuwo wonke amazwe kanye nokubusa okusemthethweni okuncane e-Latin America nase-Caribbean ufana nephethini iWits AHEAD eyibhekayo kulo lonke elaseNingizimu Yomhlaba, lapho umkhuba wansuku zonke ugijima phambi kwenqubomgomo yezikhungo.

UNESCO IESALC and United Nations University · Intergovernmental higher education body report

entry.title: University of Colorado system adopts a living policy for responsible use of AI
entry.summary:
Inqubomgomo entsha yesimiso sokuphathwa 6012 yesistimu yaseNyuvesi yaseColorado, ethi Ukusetshenziswa Okunesibopho Kobuhlakani Bokwenziwa, isiqale ukusebenza ngomhla ka-24 Agasti 2026 futhi yaphakanyiswa kubhulogi yenqubomgomo yenyuvesi ngomhla ka-21 Septhemba. Ibeka izilindelo kusistimu yonke mayelana nobuqotho basemfundweni, ukuvikeleka kwedatha, ukusobala kanye nokuhlola ukuchaneka kokuqukethwe okukhiqizwe i-AI, futhi ibekwa ngokusobala njengenqubomgomo ehlose ukuguquka njengoba impendulo ivela kubafundi nabasebenzi.

Kungani kubalulekile ku-AHEAD: Kwensika 1, i-AI ekhiqizayo kwimfundo ephakeme, ukufundisa, ukuhlola kanye nobuqotho, isistimu enkulu yenyuvesi kahulumeni ekhethe ukuphatha imithetho yayo ye-AI njengombhalo ophilayo esikhundleni senqubomgomo emile, kunika iWits AHEAD isilinganiso esivela eNyakatho Yomhlaba yezinqumo zokubusa ezilandelayo eNingizimu Yomhlaba.

University of Colorado · University policy announcement
